drafts.title: Director reviews manual annually
drafts.requirement_text: The Director of Safety & Health reviews the manual at least once a year and issues revisions with a revision log.
drafts.quote: The Director of Safety & Health owns this manual, reviews it at least once a year and issues revisions with a revision log.

drafts.title: Designate competent safety representative
drafts.requirement_text: Every subcontractor shall designate a competent on-site safety representative for each project, by name, before mobilization.
drafts.quote: Every subcontractor shall designate a competent on-site safety representative for each project, by name, before mobilization.

drafts.title: Apply most stringent requirement
drafts.requirement_text: Where this manual, the contract documents and OSHA differ, the most stringent requirement applies.
drafts.quote: Where this manual, the contract documents and OSHA differ, the most stringent requirement applies.

drafts.title: Prequalify subcontractors; valid 24 months
drafts.requirement_text: Subcontractors shall be prequalified before a subcontract is issued. Prequalification is valid for 24 months unless the subcontractor's safety performance changes materially.
drafts.quote: Subcontractors shall be prequalified before a subcontract is issued. Prequalification is valid for 24 months

drafts.title: Prequalification requires documents
drafts.requirement_text: Prequalification requires the three most recent years of EMR, OSHA 300A summaries and hours worked, a certificate of insurance and a copy of the written safety program.
drafts.quote: Prequalification requires the three most recent years of EMR, OSHA 300A summaries and hours worked, a certificate of insurance and a copy of the written safety program.

drafts.title: EMR/TRIR/citation thresholds require VP approval
drafts.requirement_text: An EMR above 1.00, a three-year average TRIR above 3.0, or any willful or repeat OSHA citation in the last three years requires written approval by the VP of Operations, with conditions.
drafts.quote: An EMR above 1.00, a three-year average TRIR above 3.0, or any willful or repeat OSHA citation in the last three years requires written approval by the VP of Operations, with conditions.

drafts.title: Insurance minimums and naming requirements
drafts.requirement_text: Minimum insurance: general liability $2,000,000 per occurrence / $4,000,000 aggregate; workers' compensation at statutory limits with employer's liability of $1,000,000; umbrella of $5,000,000 for high-risk trades. Brightwater and the owner are named additional insured.
drafts.quote: Minimum insurance: general liability $2,000,000 per occurrence / $4,000,000 aggregate; workers' compensation at statutory limits with employer's liability of $1,000,000; umbrella of $5,000,000 for high-risk trades.

drafts.title: Keep certificates of insurance current
drafts.requirement_text: Certificates of insurance shall be current at all times. A subcontractor whose certificate lapses shall not work on site until a current certificate is received.
drafts.quote: Certificates of insurance shall be current at all times. A subcontractor whose certificate lapses shall not work on site until a current certificate is received.

drafts.title: Submit site-specific safety plan
drafts.requirement_text: Each subcontractor shall submit a site-specific safety plan within 10 working days of award and before mobilization.
drafts.quote: Each subcontractor shall submit a site-specific safety plan within 10 working days of award and before mobilization.

drafts.title: Safety plan must include scope and analysis
drafts.requirement_text: The plan shall include the subcontractor's scope, hazard analysis for each high-risk activity, competent persons, emergency contacts and a training matrix.
drafts.quote: The plan shall include the subcontractor's scope, hazard analysis for each high-risk activity, competent persons, emergency contacts and a training matrix.

drafts.title: PSM approval before work starts
drafts.requirement_text: Brightwater's Project Safety Manager reviews and approves the plan. Work may not start until it is approved.
drafts.quote: Brightwater's Project Safety Manager reviews and approves the plan. Work may not start until it is approved.

drafts.title: Complete activity hazard analyses before phases
drafts.requirement_text: Activity hazard analyses (AHAs) shall be completed before each new phase of work and reviewed with the crew.
drafts.quote: Activity hazard analyses (AHAs) shall be completed before each new phase of work and reviewed with the crew.

drafts.title: Complete site orientation before starting
drafts.requirement_text: Every person working on a Brightwater site shall complete the Brightwater site orientation before starting work.
drafts.quote: Every person working on a Brightwater site shall complete the Brightwater site orientation before starting work.

drafts.title: Healthcare infection control orientation
drafts.requirement_text: On healthcare projects, workers in or next to occupied areas shall also complete the owner's infection control and hospital awareness module.
drafts.quote: On healthcare projects, workers in or next to occupied areas shall also complete the owner's infection control and hospital awareness module.

drafts.title: Maintain training records; produce within 24 hours
drafts.requirement_text: Subcontractors keep their own training records and shall produce them on request within 24 hours.
drafts.quote: Subcontractors keep their own training records and shall produce them on request within 24 hours.

drafts.title: Fall protection at 6 feet and above
drafts.requirement_text: Fall protection is required at 6 feet or more above a lower level for all trades and all activities, including steel erection and leading-edge work.
drafts.quote: Fall protection is required at 6 feet or more above a lower level for all trades and all activities, including steel erection and leading-edge work.

drafts.title: Scaffold guardrails at 6 feet
drafts.requirement_text: Scaffolds shall have guardrails at 6 feet; the OSHA 10-foot scaffold trigger does not apply on Brightwater sites.
drafts.quote: Scaffolds shall have guardrails at 6 feet; the OSHA 10-foot scaffold trigger does not apply on Brightwater sites.

drafts.title: Inspect and anchor fall arrest systems
drafts.requirement_text: Personal fall arrest systems shall be inspected before each use and anchored to anchors rated for 5,000 lb or designed by a qualified person.
drafts.quote: Personal fall arrest systems shall be inspected before each use and anchored to anchors rated for 5,000 lb or designed by a qualified person.

drafts.title: Cover and mark floor/roof openings
drafts.requirement_text: Floor and roof openings shall be covered, secured and marked "HOLE" or "COVER" as soon as they are created.
drafts.quote: Floor and roof openings shall be covered, secured and marked "HOLE" or "COVER" as soon as they are created.

drafts.title: Ladder use above 6 feet requires approval
drafts.requirement_text: Ladders are a last resort. Use of step or extension ladders above 6 feet requires the superintendent's approval of a ladder use plan.
drafts.quote: Use of step or extension ladders above 6 feet requires the superintendent's approval of a ladder use plan.

drafts.title: Aerial lift operators trained; boom occupants tied off
drafts.requirement_text: Aerial lift operators shall be trained and familiarized on the model used; occupants of boom lifts shall be tied off to the manufacturer's anchor.
drafts.quote: Aerial lift operators shall be trained and familiarized on the model used; occupants of boom lifts shall be tied off to the manufacturer's anchor.

drafts.title: 811 locate ticket and private utility location
drafts.requirement_text: Before any digging, a Sunshine 811 locate ticket shall be current and private utilities located by a private locator.
drafts.quote: Before any digging, a Sunshine 811 locate ticket shall be current and private utilities located by a private locator.

drafts.title: Excavation protective systems based on depth
drafts.requirement_text: Excavations 5 feet or deeper shall have a protective system; excavations over 20 feet shall have a protective system designed by a registered professional engineer.
drafts.quote: Excavations 5 feet or deeper shall have a protective system; excavations over 20 feet shall have a protective system designed by a registered professional engineer.

drafts.title: Daily excavation inspections and record keeping
drafts.requirement_text: A competent person shall inspect excavations daily, after every rain event and after any change in conditions, and record the inspection.
drafts.quote: A competent person shall inspect excavations daily, after every rain event and after any change in conditions, and record the inspection.

drafts.title: Spoil and equipment setback from excavation
drafts.requirement_text: Spoil and equipment shall be kept at least 2 feet from the edge of an excavation.
drafts.quote: Spoil and equipment shall be kept at least 2 feet from the edge of an excavation.

drafts.title: Hot work permit required outside shops
drafts.requirement_text: All welding, cutting, brazing and grinding outside designated shop areas requires a Brightwater hot work permit.
drafts.quote: All welding, cutting, brazing and grinding outside designated shop areas requires a Brightwater hot work permit.

drafts.title: Combustible removal and fire watch for hot work
drafts.requirement_text: Combustibles within 35 feet shall be removed or protected, and a fire watch shall be maintained during the work and for 60 minutes after it ends.
drafts.quote: Combustibles within 35 feet shall be removed or protected, and a fire watch shall be maintained during the work and for 60 minutes after it ends.

drafts.title: Healthcare hot work requires ILSM and owner approval
drafts.requirement_text: Hot work in or next to an occupied healthcare building also requires an interim life safety measures (ILSM) assessment and the owner's approval before the permit is issued.
drafts.quote: Hot work in or next to an occupied healthcare building also requires an interim life safety measures (ILSM) assessment and the owner's approval before the permit is issued.

drafts.title: Fire protection impairment notice required
drafts.requirement_text: Fire protection systems shall not be impaired without an approved impairment notice; the owner shall be notified and a fire watch posted for the duration.
drafts.quote: Fire protection systems shall not be impaired without an approved impairment notice; the owner shall be notified and a fire watch posted for the duration.

drafts.title: LOTO follows written program with individual locks
drafts.requirement_text: Lockout/tagout shall follow the subcontractor's written energy control program, reviewed by Brightwater, with individual locks for each worker.
drafts.quote: Lockout/tagout shall follow the subcontractor's written energy control program, reviewed by Brightwater, with individual locks for each worker.

drafts.title: Verify zero energy before work begins
drafts.requirement_text: Zero energy shall be verified by try-out and testing before work begins.
drafts.quote: Zero energy shall be verified by try-out and testing before work begins.

drafts.title: Hospital tie-in coordination with 14-day notice
drafts.requirement_text: Tie-ins to existing hospital systems shall be coordinated through the owner's utility shutdown request process with at least 14 calendar days' notice.
drafts.quote: Tie-ins to existing hospital systems shall be coordinated through the owner's utility shutdown request process with at least 14 calendar days' notice.

drafts.title: Energized electrical work requires permit and signatures
drafts.requirement_text: Energized electrical work is prohibited unless justified under NFPA 70E and authorized on an energized electrical work permit signed by the subcontractor, Brightwater's Project Safety Manager and the Project Manager.
drafts.quote: Energized electrical work is prohibited unless justified under NFPA 70E and authorized on an energized electrical work permit signed by the subcontractor, Brightwater's Project Safety Manager and the Project Manager.

drafts.title: Temporary power GFCI protection and cord inspection
drafts.requirement_text: Temporary power shall be GFCI protected, and cords inspected daily.
drafts.quote: Temporary power shall be GFCI protected, and cords inspected daily.

drafts.title: Critical lift plan requirements
drafts.requirement_text: A critical lift plan is required for any lift above 75% of the crane's rated capacity, tandem lifts, personnel lifts, and any lift over an occupied building or occupied area.
drafts.quote: A critical lift plan is required for any lift above 75% of the crane's rated capacity, tandem lifts, personnel lifts, and any lift over an occupied building or occupied area.

drafts.title: Critical lift plans submitted 48 hours; PSM approval
drafts.requirement_text: Critical lift plans shall be submitted at least 48 hours before the lift and approved by Brightwater's Project Safety Manager.
drafts.quote: Critical lift plans shall be submitted at least 48 hours before the lift and approved by Brightwater's Project Safety Manager.

drafts.title: No loads over occupied hospital without plan
drafts.requirement_text: Loads shall not be lifted over the occupied hospital unless the owner has approved a written evacuation or protection plan for the affected area.
drafts.quote: Loads shall not be lifted over the occupied hospital unless the owner has approved a written evacuation or protection plan for the affected area.

drafts.title: Lift personnel credentials required on site
drafts.requirement_text: Operators shall be certified; riggers and signal persons qualified, with proof available on site.
drafts.quote: Operators shall be certified; riggers and signal persons qualified, with proof available on site.

drafts.title: Permit-required confined space entry
drafts.requirement_text: Permit-required confined spaces shall be entered only under a written entry permit with atmospheric testing and a rescue plan.
drafts.quote: Permit-required confined spaces shall be entered only under a written entry permit with atmospheric testing and a rescue plan.

drafts.title: Silica task controls per regulation or assessment
drafts.requirement_text: Silica-generating tasks shall follow Table 1 of 29 CFR 1926.1153 or an exposure assessment.
drafts.quote: Silica-generating tasks shall follow Table 1 of 29 CFR 1926.1153 or an exposure assessment.

drafts.title: Asbestos/lead survey before hospital disturbance
drafts.requirement_text: Work that disturbs ceilings, walls or floors in an existing hospital area requires an asbestos and lead survey review before work starts.
drafts.quote: Work that disturbs ceilings, walls or floors in an existing hospital area requires an asbestos and lead survey review before work starts.

drafts.title: Noise/vibration limits and monitoring
drafts.requirement_text: Noise and vibration next to occupied patient areas shall stay within the limits set by the owner, and shall be monitored when the owner requests it.
drafts.quote: Noise and vibration next to occupied patient areas shall stay within the limits set by the owner, and shall be monitored when the owner requests it.

drafts.title: Minimum PPE requirements
drafts.requirement_text: Minimum PPE: hard hat (Type II on steel and crane work), safety glasses, high-visibility garment (Class 2), gloves suited to the task and safety-toe boots.
drafts.quote: Minimum PPE: hard hat (Type II on steel and crane work), safety glasses, high-visibility garment (Class 2), gloves suited to the task and safety-toe boots.

drafts.title: Daily work area cleaning and clear exits
drafts.requirement_text: Work areas shall be cleaned daily; walkways and exits kept clear at all times.
drafts.quote: Work areas shall be cleaned daily; walkways and exits kept clear at all times.

drafts.title: Hospital entrances and fire lanes unobstructed
drafts.requirement_text: Hospital entrances, ambulance routes and fire lanes shall never be blocked, even temporarily.
drafts.quote: Hospital entrances, ambulance routes and fire lanes shall never be blocked, even temporarily.

drafts.title: ICRA and permit before healthcare work
drafts.requirement_text: An infection control risk assessment (ICRA) and ICRA permit shall be in place before any work in or next to an occupied healthcare area. The permit class sets the controls.
drafts.quote: An infection control risk assessment (ICRA) and ICRA permit shall be in place before any work in or next to an occupied healthcare area.

drafts.title: Class III/IV barriers, negative pressure, HEPA exhaust
drafts.requirement_text: Class III and IV work requires hard barriers sealed floor to deck, negative air pressure verified and recorded at least daily, and HEPA-filtered exhaust.
drafts.quote: Class III and IV work requires hard barriers sealed floor to deck, negative air pressure verified and recorded at least daily, and HEPA-filtered exhaust.

drafts.title: Barrier inspection and breach response
drafts.requirement_text: Barriers shall be inspected daily by the subcontractor and weekly by the owner's infection prevention staff; any breach stops the work until it is repaired.
drafts.quote: Barriers shall be inspected daily by the subcontractor and weekly by the owner's infection prevention staff; any breach stops the work until it is repaired.

drafts.title: Weekly documented site inspection
drafts.requirement_text: The superintendent performs a documented weekly site inspection.
drafts.quote: The superintendent performs a documented weekly site inspection.

drafts.title: PSM audits subcontractors monthly
drafts.requirement_text: The Project Safety Manager audits each subcontractor at least monthly.
drafts.quote: The Project Safety Manager audits each subcontractor at least monthly.

drafts.title: Healthcare joint monthly safety walk
drafts.requirement_text: On healthcare projects, a joint monthly walk with the owner covers the connection areas.
drafts.quote: On healthcare projects, a joint monthly walk with the owner covers the connection areas.

drafts.title: Corrective action correction times
drafts.requirement_text: Imminent danger shall be corrected immediately and the work stopped until it is; Serious within 24 hours; all others within 7 days.
drafts.quote: Imminent danger shall be corrected immediately and the work stopped until it is; Serious within 24 hours; all others within 7 days.

drafts.title: Escalation for late corrective actions
drafts.requirement_text: Corrective actions not closed on time are escalated to the subcontractor's project manager, then its principal after 2 days, then Brightwater's VP of Operations after 5 days.
drafts.quote: Corrective actions not closed on time are escalated to the subcontractor's project manager, then its principal after 2 days, then Brightwater's VP of Operations after 5 days.

drafts.title: Report injuries and near misses immediately
drafts.requirement_text: All injuries, near misses and property damage shall be reported to the superintendent immediately and in writing within 1 hour.
drafts.quote: All injuries, near misses and property damage shall be reported to the superintendent immediately and in writing within 1 hour.

drafts.title: Serious incident investigation within 72 hours
drafts.requirement_text: Serious incidents are investigated to root cause within 72 hours with a written report.
drafts.quote: Serious incidents are investigated to root cause within 72 hours with a written report.

drafts.title: Submit monthly hours and injury data
drafts.requirement_text: Subcontractors submit monthly hours worked and injury data by the 5th of the following month.
drafts.quote: Subcontractors submit monthly hours worked and injury data by the 5th of the following month.

drafts.title: Authority and obligation to stop unsafe work
drafts.requirement_text: Every person on site has the authority and the obligation to stop work that is unsafe. No one will be disciplined for a good-faith stop.
drafts.quote: Every person on site has the authority and the obligation to stop work that is unsafe. No one will be disciplined for a good-faith stop.

drafts.title: Restart imminent danger work after approval
drafts.requirement_text: Work stopped for an imminent danger restarts only after the superintendent and the subcontractor's foreman agree the hazard is controlled, and the Project Safety Manager is informed.
drafts.quote: Work stopped for an imminent danger restarts only after the superintendent and the subcontractor's foreman agree the hazard is controlled, and the Project Safety Manager is informed.

drafts.title: Drug and alcohol testing program
drafts.requirement_text: Subcontractors shall maintain a drug and alcohol program with pre-access, post-incident and reasonable-suspicion testing.
drafts.quote: Subcontractors shall maintain a drug and alcohol program with pre-access, post-incident and reasonable-suspicion testing.

drafts.title: Contractor evaluation and status assignment
drafts.requirement_text: Each subcontractor is evaluated at completion of its scope on safety performance, corrective action timeliness and plan quality. The result sets its status for future bids: Preferred, Approved or Conditional.
drafts.quote: Each subcontractor is evaluated at completion of its scope on safety performance, corrective action timeliness and plan quality. The result sets its status for future bids: Preferred, Approved or Conditional.

drafts.title: Serious injury/near miss triggers performance plan
drafts.requirement_text: A serious injury or a serious near miss places the subcontractor on Conditional status with a performance improvement plan for 12 months.
drafts.quote: A serious injury or a serious near miss places the subcontractor on Conditional status with a performance improvement plan for 12 months.
